entity_noun: certification, accreditation, registration, standard, or compliance

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it:

rules.text: At least one {{entity_noun}} can be identified from the phrase and its relationship summary.

children.text: The {{entity_noun}} must be identifiable by its own name, number, or issuing body from the phrase and its relationship summary. Meeting a customer's or an industry's specifications, or operating quality assurance systems, is not itself a nameable {{entity_noun}} — never substitute a named standard the phrase and summary do not name. A statement of commitment, values, or goals, or general praise of quality, reliability, or standing, names nothing that could specifically be held, met, or followed, and identifies no {{entity_noun}}.

rules.text: The phrase and its relationship summary show real, concrete involvement with the identified {{entity_noun}}: some party is shown to {{entity_relationships.base}} that {{entity_noun}}, not merely to name, list, or mention it in passing.

children.text: A {{entity_noun}} the manufacturer itself displays, lists, or publishes as its own — a certificate bearing its name, a certificate number, an issuing body, a document it offers for viewing or download — is concrete evidence of {{entity_relationships.gerund}} it. Publishing one's own certificate is how holding it is shown, not a mere mention in passing.

rules.text: It is the manufacturer itself that {{entity_relationships.third_person}} the identified {{entity_noun}} — not a customer, supplier, distributor, or other third party that the manufacturer merely relates to.

sections.heading: A candidate {{entity_noun}} is ruled out if ANY of these guards is violated by it. Ruling out one candidate does not reject the phrase — another candidate may still qualify:

rules.text: The manufacturer's involvement in the identified {{entity_noun}} is only aspirational, hoped-for, planned, in-progress, or discontinued, rather than current and actual.
